01 / A FALSE SWITCH

The direction stayed.
The decoder changed.

Choose “Shrink without noise.” The state remains aligned with the source. Cosine still selects it. Euclidean distance can prefer a shorter competitor because candidate norms also enter the score.

score(j) = 2nⱼ uⱼ · s − nⱼ²

The last term does not shrink with the state. The toy gives candidates unequal lengths on purpose. The original token identity here is a geometric label, not sentence meaning.

02 / COMPETITION

A boundary,
not a blur.

A rival passes the source when its advantage along the noise direction beats its separation from the source. The exact thresholds determine the source’s rank along this fixed path.

κ > (1 − uᵢ · uⱼ) / (uⱼ · z − uᵢ · z)

Only positive denominators can cross. All ranking uses full-space dot products. The display projects into the source/noise plane; distances between plotted points are not full-space distances.

03 / REASSIGN THE CLOCK

Put steps where
rankings change.

LLaCO (23 Oct 2026) combines spherical noising and semantic retention scheduling for continuous diffusion language modeling. The paper calibrates its clock on pretrained token geometry.

t(γ) = 0.9 H(γ) + 0.1 γ

Here H is a smoothed log-rank loss from one synthetic path. Reallocating dots does not establish better text or faster inference. No denoiser runs in this lab.

What this does—and what it measures

Seeded random unit directions in 8–512 dimensions, with orthogonal unit source and noise endpoints. We retain their exact projections on that plane; this is sufficient to calculate dot products with every state on the path. Candidate lengths vary only for the Euclidean comparison. Competition mode uses linear interpolation or a quarter-circle SLERP. Shrink mode adds zero noise and stops at norm 0.05, so direction remains defined. The adaptive grid uses logistic smoothing of exact thresholds (width 0.012), endpoint-normalized log rank and a 10% linear floor. It is not the paper’s mask-biased endpoint, empirical vocabulary fit, high-dimensional probability model, training or reverse sampler. Playing backwards retraces known geometry; it does not generate language. Arbitrary token IDs are not learned words. Original code and graphics; no copied paper figures.
